messages:
rene: Heads-up: Customer asking for a granular subprocessor list with backup locations for their SIG review. Theyre also pushing for confirmation that metrics and logs for the POC will remain in SG. Can we get a signed manifest and a one-page network diagram?

ccie: We have two options: Hosted (asia-southeast1) with scoped backups, or Dedicated in SEA (longer setup). Which does the sales team prefer?

maria: Sales prefers Hosted for speed. Customer legal insists on a signed subprocessor manifest for the POC and wants the flow diagram to show no cross-region replication.

sec-bot: Security note: CAIQ references attached: SC-8, SC-13, SE-6. Recommend adding an ops attestation: "no human inspection of raw requests without formal request & authorization".

rene: Good. Presales - can you upload a manifest and a DPA addendum for POC? Also they want a CSV with columns: vendor, service, primary_region, backup_region, backup_encrypted, contact, soc_links.

presales-bot: uploaded -> https://redwood.internal/presales/poc-signed-manifest-1803005555 (subprocessors.csv, poc-dpa-addendum.pdf, flow-diagram-sg.png) :file_folder:

ccie: Inline ASCII flow for quick slides:

``
Client App (SG) -> TLS -> Edge Node (asia-southeast1) -> Model Inference (asia-southeast1)
                           -> KV cache (asia-southeast1)
Backups -> GCS bucket (asia-southeast1 only for POC)
Logs/metrics -> Regional metrics endpoint (aggregated)
```

maria: Great, I'll send the bundle to the customer's legal counsel and note that the manifest is POC-scoped. rene: can you confirm the signed-manifest includes a line: "Backups pinned to asia-southeast1 for POC window"?

rene: Confirmed. It's in the signed manifest with a POC expiration date and signature by ops lead.

maria: Thanks everyone :white_check_mark:
